thag2.42:1.1: yo have daharo bhikkhu yuñjati buddhasāsane, jāgaro patisuttesu amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ. tasmā saddhañca sīlañca pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ, anuyuñjetha medhāvī saraṃ buddhāna sāsana’nti. itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā dhammapālo thero gāthāyo abhāsitthā’ti. dhammapālattheragāthā. 2. 5. 3. kassindriyāni samathaṅgatāni assā
